texts.label: section_header
texts.text: Assurance Continuity Maintenance Report:

texts.label: text
texts.text: Leidos submitted an Impact Analysis Report (IAR) and Assurance Continuity Maintenance package to the Common Criteria Evaluation Validation Scheme (CCEVS) for approval on July 18, 2025 on behalf of Veeam Software. The IAR is intended to satisfy requirements outlined in Common Criteria Evaluation and Validation Scheme Publication #6, Assurance Continuity: Guidance for Maintenance and Re-evaluation , version 3.0. In accordance with those requirements, the IAR describes the changes made to the certified TOE, the evidence updated because of the changes, and the security impact of the changes.

texts.label: text
texts.text: The evaluation evidence submitted for consideration consists of the Security Target (ST), the Administrator's Guides, and the Impact Analysis Report (IAR). The ST and CC Admin Guide were updated.
